name: CompleteCare Veterinary Center
notes: A Staten Island veterinary hospital at 1293 Clove Rd, (718) 720-4211. It is not open 24 hours (a reviewer rang on 2026-11-04): for an emergency outside these hours, go to a 24-hour hospital such as Greater Staten Island Veterinary Specialists or VEG New Dorp.
section: Emergency & poison control — STATEN ISLAND - 24 hour ER

change_log.note: Its website, completecarevets.com, refused every automated read on 2026-11-04. A search index of its contact page shows "Open today 08:00 am - 08:00 pm" at 1293 Clove Road; Yelp shows daytime hours with Sunday closed; it is not on the Mayor's Alliance emergency list. Only Bideawee's old list says 24 hours. The listing no longer claims to be open around the clock. Number and address unchanged. A person should open the site in a normal browser.
